overview_description.description: AuthZed is a company focused on providing solutions for building fine-grained authorization services. The company offers a managed service called AuthZed Dedicated, which provides a production-ready version of its open-source project SpiceDB, designed to deliver highly available, consistent, and performant authorization at global scale. AuthZed also licenses the SpiceDB Enterprise package, which includes additional enterprise functionality for self-hosted deployments.

about_short_description.short_description: AuthZed is a permissions systems provider that helps organizations build fast, secure, and scalable authorization services for applications.

product.name: SpiceDB
product.description: A scalable, consistent database inspired by Google Zanzibar for storing and computing fine-grained authorization data.

product.name: AuthZed Dedicated
product.description: A dedicated cloud platform providing isolated, reserved compute resources for deploying SpiceDB with private networking and regional control.

product.name: AuthZed Cloud (Preview)
product.description: A shared control plane cloud service for managing SpiceDB deployments with self-service provisioning and API access.

product.name: SpiceDB Operator
product.description: A Kubernetes controller for managing SpiceDB clusters, enabling deployment, scaling, and zero-downtime migrations.

product.name: AuthZed Cloud API
product.description: A RESTful JSON API for managing AuthZed Dedicated Cloud infrastructure and permissions systems programmatically.
